designs.title: No.
designs.why: I get the joke instantly: an unimpressed cat lounging on top of a big 'NO' and batting the full stop off like a toy. The sulky half-closed eyes are spot on and very relatable, and it reads clearly from across the room on both the white and black tee. What holds it back is the striped fill in the letters and the hatched tail. Up close they look a bit scratchy and busy, so the print feels less clean than the cat's face does, and at $50 I want it to look tidy.
designs.fix: Make the letter stripes calmer and more regular (fewer, cleaner tabby bands) and simplify the tail hatching so the 'NO' and the cat read as one clean, confident graphic.
